name: Should I hire my own electrician or let the general contractor coordinate one?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire my own electrician or let the general contractor coordinate one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring your own electrician requires you to manage sequencing, job-site access, and accountability yourself. When HH Remodeling coordinates electrical sub-trades, Abraham Becerra personally oversees the workflow on-site. If an electrician needs an extra stud moved or a drywall opening adjusted, our carpentry team handles it immediately. Managing trades independently often leads to scheduling conflicts, finger-pointing over wall patching, or extended gaps where your remodel sits idle waiting for the next contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Letting your general contractor coordinate electrical work avoids scheduling conflicts, ensures smooth trade handoffs, and gives you a single point of contact.
